symptom: Layout breaks when resizing: an absolutely positioned box jumps between the capture viewports instead of tracking the author fluid anchor.

callSite.detail: suppress_derived_insets runs last, after styles.extend(authored), so it arbitrates the final merged map. Implementation in src/generate/authored_css_insets.rs. This one site serves BOTH emission paths: the base declarations (responsive_output.rs) and the per-viewport media bands (responsive_node_rules.rs:49), which both call normalize_indexed.

mechanism: Capture reads getComputedStyle, which returns USED pixels, so the generator cannot distinguish an authored right:30% from an engine-derived left:864px and emits both. Per CSS 2.1 section 10.3.7 an absolutely positioned box with left, width and right all non-auto is over-constrained, and in a left-to-right direction the engine ignores right - the AUTHOR declaration. The frozen left therefore wins and the fluid anchor becomes dead code, producing a step function pinned to the capture viewports 1920/1440/768/390/320.

rule.statement: On an absolute or fixed box, drop a derived pixel inset only on an axis where the author anchored the OPPOSITE edge. Removal is the repair: an absent inset is auto, which is precisely the unknown the over-constraint equation solves for, so the box re-derives its offset at every width instead of at one.
rule.testedAgainst: the AUTHORED cascade (authored_css Index), never computed style
rule.neitherEdgeAuthored: KEPT - no competing declaration exists, the box is not over-constrained, and the sampled pixel is the only positional information there is. Dropping insets unconditionally would break every page positioned by sampling alone.
rule.bothEdgesAuthored: UNTOUCHED - the cascade is entirely the author own.
rule.staticAndRelative: UNTOUCHED - offsets on a static box are inert, and a relative box has no width term so the over-constraint equation does not apply.
rule.logicalNames: inset-inline-start/end, inset-block-start/end, inset-inline, inset-block and inset all count as anchors, because authored_css_rules::physical_property maps only the size logicals and returns empty for every inset name.
rule.writingMode: Vertical writing modes are declined rather than guessed, since the inline axis is vertical there and an LTR mapping would arbitrate the wrong axis.
rule.shorthand: inset/inset-block/inset-inline are expanded into physical longhands before arbitration, because a shorthand re-states every edge it covers and would otherwise smuggle the derived pixel back. A shorthand containing a function is left intact.

oracle.what: Rendered box geometry from getBoundingClientRect, compared source page against generated recreation, at 19 widths from 320 to 1920.
oracle.keying: tag plus trimmed text or aria-label, never a selector, so the two sides are matched by identity rather than by structure.
oracle.bidirectional: sourceOnly and recreationOnly counted in both directions at every width; a box present on one side only is a miss, not a match.
oracle.whyNotDeclarationCounts: A declaration count can be improved by deleting declarations. Only rendered geometry can show the box tracks the anchor.

frozenOffset.frozenLeftAfter: none - no left in base or any media band
frozenOffset.note: The five widths clean BEFORE are exactly the five capture viewports - the step-function signature.

wrapCollision.note: Improves at 14 of 19 widths and regresses at none. The residual mismatches are other boxes on the page whose cause is a different defect, not this one.

noFluidAnchorPage.declarationsChanged: one rule (.gamma, authored left:1100px top:700px) lost the derived right:700px and bottom:340px
noFluidAnchorPage.renderedGeometry: IDENTICAL - all 9 elements, all rects, at 320/480/768/1024/1280/1440/1920, zero differing
noFluidAnchorPage.why: The removed declarations are precisely the ones CSS already discards as over-constrained, so removing them cannot move the box.
